senses.gloss: f. (שָלַב) [what is fitted in,] shelf; step, rundle.
units: <cite ref="Makkot 7b:13">Macc. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>היה</he> … <he>ונשמטה ש׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>נשמט הש׳</he>, corr. acc.) if one is going up a ladder, and a rundle slips from under him &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 7:1:6">Y. Erub. VII, beg. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>בין ש׳ לש׳ וכ׳</he> between each two steps a space of less than &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 7:1:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ש׳ עבה</he> a wide-stepped ladder or stair; a. e.—Pl. <he>שְׁלִיבוֹת</he>, <he>שְׁלִיבִים</he>. Bab.
Erub. 77ᵇ סולם שׁשְׁלִיבוֹתָיו פורחות an ascent with flying steps, i.e. stairs without foundation and back, step-ladder, opp. to a solid stair-case.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:3:3">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵇ</cite> <he>אחר שְׁלִיבָיו</he> it depends on the material of its steps (or shelves); Bab.

<cite ref="Shabbat 60a:1">Sabb. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>שליבותיו</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 3:13">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 13</cite> <he>השְׁלוּבִים</he>, <he>השְׁלוּבִין</he>, v. <cite ref="S00322"><he>קוּלָב</he> I</cite>.
